newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine April industrial output up 7.9 pct -FIEL.
newsitem.headline: Argentine April industrial output up 7.9 pct -FIEL.

text.p: Argentina's industrial output in April rose 7.9 percent on April last year, while for the year to date it was 7.6 percent higher than the first four months of 1996, the private consultancy FIEL said in preliminary data released Wednesday.
April's industrial production was 4.3 percent higher than in March.
April's preliminary result compares with economists' average forecasts of 7.2 percent year-on-year.
FIEL said its revised industrial output figures for April would be released on May 26.
